239: async fn dav_event_resource(
240:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
241:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key, resource_name)): Path<(String, String, String)>,
242:     request: Request,
243: ) -> Response {
244:     match request.method().as_str() {
245:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
246:         "GET" | "HEAD" => {
247:             let head = request.method().as_str() == "HEAD";
248:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
249:                 return dav_unauthorized();
250:             };
251:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
252:                 return dav_unauthorized();
253:             };
254:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
255:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
256:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
257:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
258:             };
259:             if principal.user_id != session.user_id {
260:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
261:             }
262:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
263:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
264:             };
265:             let calendar = match accounts
266:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
267:                 .await
268:             {
269:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
270:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
271:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
272:             };
273:             let path_principal_ok =
274:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
275:             if !path_principal_ok {
276:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
277:             }
278:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
279:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
280:             };
281:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
282:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
283:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
284:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
285:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
286:             };
287:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
288:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
289:                 .await
290:             {
291:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
292:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
293:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
294:             };
295:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
296:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
297:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
298:                  )",
299:             )
300:             .bind(resource.event_id)
301:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
302:             .await
303:             .unwrap_or(false);
304:             if recurring {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             }
307:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
308:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
309:             };
310:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
311:             let mut response = (
312:                 StatusCode::OK,
313:                 [
314:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
315:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
316:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
317:                 ],
318:                 ical,
319:             )
320:                 .into_response();
321:             if head {
322:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
323:             }
324:             response
325:         }
326:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
327:     }
328: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }
828: 
829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

102: fn escape_text(text: &str) -> String {
103:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());
104:     for ch in text.chars() {
105:         match ch {
106:             '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
107:             ';' => out.push_str("\\;"),
108:             ',' => out.push_str("\\,"),
109:             '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
110:             '\r' => out.push_str("\\n"),
111:             _ => out.push(ch),

113:     }

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out
150: }

+fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {

+    };
+    let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
+        uid: resource.uid.clone(),
+        summary: event.title.clone(),
+        description: event.description.clone(),
+        location: event.location.clone(),
+        status: Some(
+            match event.status {
+                EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
+                EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
+                EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
+            }

+        end_utc: *end_utc,
+        timezone: timezone.clone(),
+        dtstamp: event.created_at,

+    });
+    let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);

- **Acceptance:** URL/UID stay stable; ETag reflects canonical content; GET is valid VCALENDAR; HEAD matches headers without body.
- **Verify:** Migration, repository/service/HTTP tests, and iCalendar parser fixture.
- **Handoff:** Freeze resource-name, UID, and ETag rules.

## T05 — Bounded calendar query

- **Outcome:** A clean client retrieves multiple timed events in a requested range.
- **Depends on:** T04.
- **Scope:** `REPORT calendar-query`, minimal XML/filter parser, limits.
- **Changes:** Return matching href, ETag, and calendar data through the DAV service.
- **Out of scope:** Multiget, recurrence expansion, unsupported filters.
- **Acceptance:** Correct inclusion/exclusion; malformed/unsupported queries fail deterministically; bounds are enforced.
- **Verify:** Parser and HTTP tests for empty, mixed, malformed, and oversized requests.
- **Handoff:** Record accepted XML shapes/errors for T06/T18.

## T06 — Calendar multiget

- **Outcome:** Apple hydrates selected resources after discovery.
- **Depends on:** T05.
- **Scope:** Bounded `REPORT calendar-multiget` within one authorized collection.
- **Changes:** Parse hrefs, bulk-resolve resources, return per-resource DAV statuses.
- **Out of scope:** Writes, cross-collection batches, sync tokens.
- **Acceptance:** Existing hrefs return data/ETags; missing ones return per-item 404; foreign paths leak nothing; list size is bounded.

471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");

504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");

583:     principal_id: &str,
584:     principal: &PrincipalInfo,
585:     calendars: &[CaldavCalendar],
586:     depth: DavDepth,
587: ) -> Response {
588:     let href = format!("/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/");
589:     let displayname = xml_escape(&principal.display_name);
590:     let home_privileges = vec!["DAV:read", "DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
591:     let home_privilege_set = privilege_set_xml(&home_privileges);
592:     let home = format!(
593:         r#"  <D:response>
594:     <D:href>{href}</D:href>
595:     <D:propstat>
596:       <D:prop>
597:         <D:resourcetype>
598:           <D:collection/>
599:         </D:resourcetype>
600:         <D:displayname>{displayname}</D:displayname>
601:         <D:principal-URL>
602:           <D:href>{}</D:href>
603:         </D:principal-URL>
604: {home_privilege_set}
605:       </D:prop>
606:       <D:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</D:status>
607:     </D:propstat>
608:   </D:response>"#,
609:         accounts.principal_url(principal_id)
610:     );
611:     let children = if depth == DavDepth::One {
612:         calendars
613:             .iter()
614:             .map(|calendar| calendar_response_xml(accounts, principal_id, calendar))
615:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
616:             .join("\n")
617:     } else {
618:         String::new()
619:     };
620:     let body = if children.is_empty() {
621:         format!(
622:             r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
623: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
624: {home}
625: </D:multistatus>"#
626:         )
627:     } else {
628:         format!(
629:             r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
630: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
631: {home}
632: {children}
633: </D:multistatus>"#
634:         )
635:     };
636:     (
637:         StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
638:         [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
639:         body,
640:     )
641:         .into_response()
642: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

677: fn resource_response_xml(
678:     principal_id: &str,
679:     calendar_id: i64,
680:     resource: &CaldavEventResource,
681:     etag: &str,
682: ) -> String {
683:     let href = format!(
684:         "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{calendar_id}/{}.ics",
685:         resource.resource_name
686:     );
687:     format!(
688:         r#"  <D:response>
689:     <D:href>{href}</D:href>
690:     <D:propstat>
691:       <D:prop>
692:         <D:resourcetype>
693:           <C:calendar-component/>
694:           <C:vevent/>
695:         </D:resourcetype>
696:         <D:getetag>{etag}</D:getetag>
697:         <D:getcontenttype>text/calendar; charset=utf-8</D:getcontenttype>
698:       </D:prop>
699:       <D:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</D:status>
700:     </D:propstat>
701:   </D:response>"#
702:     )
703: }

773: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
789:     }
790:     let issued = accounts
791:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
792:         .await
793:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }

803: async fn revoke_apple_password(
804:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
805:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
806:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
807: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
808:     accounts
809:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
810:         .await
811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }
828: 
829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

68:     let hex: String = digest.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect();

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;

122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();

148:     }

172: async fn dav_calendar(
173:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
174:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key)): Path<(String, String)>,
175:     request: Request,
176: ) -> Response {
177:     match request.method().as_str() {
178:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
179:         PROPFIND => {
180:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
181:                 return dav_unauthorized();
182:             };
183:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
184:                 return dav_unauthorized();
185:             };
186:             let Some(depth) = parse_depth(request.headers()) else {
187:                 return dav_bad_depth();
188:             };
189:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
190:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
191:                 Ok(None) => return dav_not_found(),
192:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
193:             };
194:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
195:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
196:             };
197:             let calendar = match accounts
198:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
199:                 .await
200:             {
201:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
202:                 Ok(None) => return dav_calendar_not_found(),
203:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
204:             };
205:             let path_principal_ok =
206:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
207:             if !path_principal_ok {
208:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
209:             }
210:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
211:             let event_ids = match repository.list_exposed_event_ids(calendar_id).await {
212:                 Ok(event_ids) => event_ids,
213:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
214:             };
215:             let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
216:             let now = accounts.now();
217:             let mut listed = Vec::new();
218:             for event_id in event_ids {
219:                 let resource = match repository.ensure_resource(calendar_id, event_id, now).await {
220:                     Ok(resource) => resource,
221:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
222:                 };
223:                 match events.event(calendar_id, event_id).await {
224:                     Ok(Some(event)) => {
225:                         if let Some((_, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) {
226:                             listed.push((resource, etag));
227:                         }
228:                     }
229:                     Ok(None) => {}
230:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
231:                 }
232:             }
233:             render_calendar(&accounts, &principal_id, &calendar, depth, &listed)
234:         }
235:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
236:     }
237: }

239: async fn dav_event_resource(
240:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
241:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key, resource_name)): Path<(String, String, String)>,
242:     request: Request,
243: ) -> Response {
244:     match request.method().as_str() {
245:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
246:         "GET" | "HEAD" => {
247:             let head = request.method().as_str() == "HEAD";
248:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
249:                 return dav_unauthorized();
250:             };
251:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
252:                 return dav_unauthorized();
253:             };
254:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
255:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
256:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
257:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
258:             };
259:             if principal.user_id != session.user_id {
260:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
261:             }
262:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
263:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
264:             };
265:             let calendar = match accounts
266:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
267:                 .await
268:             {
269:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
270:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
271:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
272:             };
273:             let path_principal_ok =
274:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
275:             if !path_principal_ok {
276:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
277:             }
278:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
279:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
280:             };
281:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
282:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
283:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
284:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
285:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
286:             };
287:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
288:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
289:                 .await
290:             {
291:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
292:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
293:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
294:             };
295:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
296:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
297:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
298:                  )",
299:             )
300:             .bind(resource.event_id)
301:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
302:             .await
303:             .unwrap_or(false);
304:             if recurring {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             }
307:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
308:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
309:             };
310:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
311:             let mut response = (
312:                 StatusCode::OK,
313:                 [
314:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
315:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
316:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
317:                 ],
318:                 ical,
319:             )
320:                 .into_response();
321:             if head {
322:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
323:             }
324:             response
325:         }
326:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
327:     }
328: }

350: fn depth_is_infinite(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> bool {
351:     headers
352:         .get("depth")
353:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok())
354:         .is_some_and(|value| value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("infinity"))
355: }
356: 
357: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
358: enum DavDepth {
359:     Zero,
360:     One,
361: }
362: 
363: fn parse_depth(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> Option<DavDepth> {
364:     let value = headers.get("depth").and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
365:     match value {
366:         None => Some(DavDepth::One),
367:         Some(value) if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("0") => Some(DavDepth::Zero),
368:         Some(value) if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("1") => Some(DavDepth::One),
369:         Some(_) => None,
370:     }
371: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }

512: fn privilege_set_xml(privileges: &[&str]) -> String {

516:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
517:         .join("\n");
518:     format!(
519:         "      <D:current-user-privilege-set>\n{entries}\n      </D:current-user-privilege-set>"
520:     )
521: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

687:     format!(

705: fn render_calendar(
706:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
707:     principal_id: &str,
708:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
709:     depth: DavDepth,
710:     resources: &[(CaldavEventResource, String)],
711: ) -> Response {
712:     let response = calendar_response_xml(accounts, principal_id, calendar);
713:     let children = if depth == DavDepth::One {
714:         resources
715:             .iter()
716:             .map(|(resource, etag)| {
717:                 resource_response_xml(principal_id, calendar.calendar_id, resource, etag)
718:             })
719:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
720:             .join("\n")
721:     } else {
722:         String::new()
723:     };
724:     let body = if children.is_empty() {
725:         format!(
726:             r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
727: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
728: {response}
729: </D:multistatus>"#
730:         )
731:     } else {
732:         format!(
733:             r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
734: <D:multistatus xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:calendarserver/">
735: {response}
736: {children}
737: </D:multistatus>"#
738:         )
739:     };
740:     (
741:         StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS,
742:         [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/xml; charset=utf-8")],
743:         body,
744:     )
745:         .into_response()
746: }

770: async fn get_apple_connection(
771:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
772:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
773: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
774:     let status = accounts

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
789:     }
790:     let issued = accounts
791:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
792:         .await
793:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }
802: 
803: async fn revoke_apple_password(
804:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
805:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
806:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
807: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
808:     accounts
809:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
810:         .await
811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }
828: 
829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

510:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
511:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
512:         return None;
513:     }
514:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))

261:             }
262:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
263:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
264:             };
265:             let calendar = match accounts
266:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
267:                 .await
268:             {
269:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
270:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
271:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
272:             };
273:             let path_principal_ok =
274:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
275:             if !path_principal_ok {
276:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
277:             }
278:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
279:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
280:             };
281:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
282:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
283:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
284:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
285:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
286:             };
287:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
288:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
289:                 .await
290:             {
291:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
292:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
293:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
294:             };
295:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
296:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
297:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
298:                  )",
299:             )
300:             .bind(resource.event_id)
301:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
302:             .await
303:             .unwrap_or(false);
304:             if recurring {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             }
307:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
308:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
309:             };
310:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
311:             let mut response = (
312:                 StatusCode::OK,
313:                 [
314:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
315:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
316:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
317:                 ],
318:                 ical,
319:             )
320:                 .into_response();
321:             if head {
322:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
323:             }
324:             response
325:         }
326:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
327:     }
328: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());

794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }

812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {

141:         if !first {

143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }

21: /// Serialize one canonical VCALENDAR resource for a single timed event.
22: ///
23: /// The output is deterministic for a given input: property order is fixed,
24: /// text is escaped per RFC 5545, and long lines are folded.
25: pub fn serialize_event_resource(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
26:     let mut out = String::new();
27:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n");
28:     out.push_str("VERSION:2.0\r\n");
29:     out.push_str("PRODID:-//Happening//CalDAV 1.0//EN\r\n");
30:     out.push_str("CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n");
31:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n");
32:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("UID:{}", escape_text(&event.uid))));
33:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
34:         "DTSTAMP:{}Z",
35:         utc_timestamp(event.dtstamp)
36:     )));
37:     out.push_str(&timed_lines(event));
38:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
39:         "SUMMARY:{}",
40:         escape_text(&event.summary)
41:     )));
42:     if let Some(description) = &event.description {
43:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
44:             "DESCRIPTION:{}",

46:         )));

48:     if let Some(location) = &event.location {
49:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("LOCATION:{}", escape_text(location))));
50:     }
51:     if let Some(status) = &event.status {
52:         out.push_str(&format!("STATUS:{status}\r\n"));
53:     }
54:     out.push_str(&format!("SEQUENCE:{}\r\n", event.sequence));
55:     out.push_str("END:VEVENT\r\n");
56:     out.push_str("END:VCALENDAR\r\n");

60: /// Strong ETag derived from the canonical resource content.

63: /// reuses a value for different content.
64: pub fn etag_for_ical(content: &str) -> String {
65:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();

67:     let digest = hasher.finalize();
68:     let hex: String = digest.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect();

21: /// Serialize one canonical VCALENDAR resource for a single timed event.
22: ///
23: /// The output is deterministic for a given input: property order is fixed,
24: /// text is escaped per RFC 5545, and long lines are folded.
25: pub fn serialize_event_resource(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
26:     let mut out = String::new();
27:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n");
28:     out.push_str("VERSION:2.0\r\n");
29:     out.push_str("PRODID:-//Happening//CalDAV 1.0//EN\r\n");
30:     out.push_str("CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n");
31:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n");
32:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("UID:{}", escape_text(&event.uid))));
33:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
34:         "DTSTAMP:{}Z",
35:         utc_timestamp(event.dtstamp)
36:     )));
37:     out.push_str(&timed_lines(event));
38:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
39:         "SUMMARY:{}",
40:         escape_text(&event.summary)
41:     )));
42:     if let Some(description) = &event.description {
43:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
44:             "DESCRIPTION:{}",
45:             escape_text(description)
46:         )));
47:     }
48:     if let Some(location) = &event.location {
49:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("LOCATION:{}", escape_text(location))));
50:     }

53:     }

60: /// Strong ETag derived from the canonical resource content.
61: ///
62: /// The tag changes exactly when the serialized content changes and never
63: /// reuses a value for different content.
64: pub fn etag_for_ical(content: &str) -> String {
65:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
66:     hasher.update(content.as_bytes());
67:     let digest = hasher.finalize();
68:     let hex: String = digest.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect();
69:     format!("\"{hex}\"")

72: fn timed_lines(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {

103:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());

107:             ';' => out.push_str("\\;"),
108:             ',' => out.push_str("\\,"),
109:             '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out
150: }

/// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    let EventTiming::Timed {
        start_utc,
        end_utc,
        timezone,
    } = &event.timing
    else {
        return None;
    };
    let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
        uid: resource.uid.clone(),
        summary: event.title.clone(),
        description: event.description.clone(),
        location: event.location.clone(),
        status: Some(
            match event.status {
                EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
                EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
                EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
            }
            .to_owned(),
        ),
        start_utc: *start_utc,
        end_utc: *end_utc,
        timezone: timezone.clone(),
        dtstamp: event.created_at,
        sequence: event.version as u64,
    });
    let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
    Some((ical, etag))
}

fn resource_response_xml(
    principal_id: &str,
    calendar_id: i64,
    resource: &CaldavEventResource,
    etag: &str,
) -> String {
    let href = format!(
        "/dav/calendars/{principal_id}/{calendar_id}/{}.ics",
        resource.resource_name
    );
    format!(
        r#"  <D:response>
    <D:href>{href}</D:href>
    <D:propstat>
      <D:prop>
        <D:resourcetype>
          <C:calendar-component/>
          <C:vevent/>
        </D:resourcetype>
        <D:getetag>{etag}</D:getetag>
        <D:getcontenttype>text/calendar; charset=utf-8</D:getcontenttype>
      </D:prop>
      <D:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</D:status>
    </D:propstat>
  </D:response>"#
    )
}

fn render_calendar(
    accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
    principal_id: &str,
    calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
    depth: DavDepth,
    resources: &[(CaldavEventResource, String)],
) -> Response {
    let response = calendar_response_xml(accounts, principal_id, calendar);
    let children = if depth == DavDepth::One {
        resources
            .iter()
            .map(|(resource, etag)| {
                resource_response_xml(principal_id, calendar.calendar_id, resource, etag)
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()

575:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;

190:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
191:                 Ok(None) => return dav_not_found(),
192:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
193:             };
194:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
195:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
196:             };
197:             let calendar = match accounts
198:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
199:                 .await
200:             {
201:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
202:                 Ok(None) => return dav_calendar_not_found(),
203:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
204:             };
205:             let path_principal_ok =
206:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
207:             if !path_principal_ok {
208:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
209:             }
210:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
211:             let event_ids = match repository.list_exposed_event_ids(calendar_id).await {
212:                 Ok(event_ids) => event_ids,
213:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
214:             };
215:             let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
216:             let now = accounts.now();
217:             let mut listed = Vec::new();
218:             for event_id in event_ids {
219:                 let resource = match repository.ensure_resource(calendar_id, event_id, now).await {
220:                     Ok(resource) => resource,
221:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
222:                 };
223:                 match events.event(calendar_id, event_id).await {
224:                     Ok(Some(event)) => {
225:                         if let Some((_, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) {
226:                             listed.push((resource, etag));
227:                         }
228:                     }
229:                     Ok(None) => {}
230:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
231:                 }
232:             }
233:             render_calendar(&accounts, &principal_id, &calendar, depth, &listed)
234:         }
235:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
236:     }
237: }

239: async fn dav_event_resource(
240:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
241:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key, resource_name)): Path<(String, String, String)>,
242:     request: Request,
243: ) -> Response {
244:     match request.method().as_str() {
245:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
246:         "GET" | "HEAD" => {
247:             let head = request.method().as_str() == "HEAD";
248:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
249:                 return dav_unauthorized();
250:             };
251:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
252:                 return dav_unauthorized();
253:             };
254:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
255:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
256:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
257:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
258:             };
259:             if principal.user_id != session.user_id {
260:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
261:             }
262:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
263:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
264:             };
265:             let calendar = match accounts
266:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
267:                 .await
268:             {
269:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
270:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
271:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
272:             };
273:             let path_principal_ok =
274:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
275:             if !path_principal_ok {
276:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
277:             }
278:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
279:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
280:             };
281:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
282:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
283:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
284:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
285:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
286:             };
287:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
288:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
289:                 .await
290:             {
291:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
292:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
293:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
294:             };
295:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
296:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
297:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
298:                  )",
299:             )
300:             .bind(resource.event_id)
301:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
302:             .await
303:             .unwrap_or(false);
304:             if recurring {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             }
307:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
308:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
309:             };
310:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
311:             let mut response = (
312:                 StatusCode::OK,
313:                 [
314:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
315:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
316:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
317:                 ],
318:                 ical,
319:             )
320:                 .into_response();
321:             if head {
322:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
323:             }
324:             response
325:         }
326:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
327:     }
328: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }
828: 
829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

23: /// The output is deterministic for a given input: property order is fixed,
24: /// text is escaped per RFC 5545, and long lines are folded.
25: pub fn serialize_event_resource(event: &CaldavIcalEvent) -> String {
26:     let mut out = String::new();
27:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n");
28:     out.push_str("VERSION:2.0\r\n");
29:     out.push_str("PRODID:-//Happening//CalDAV 1.0//EN\r\n");
30:     out.push_str("CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n");
31:     out.push_str("BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n");
32:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("UID:{}", escape_text(&event.uid))));
33:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
34:         "DTSTAMP:{}Z",
35:         utc_timestamp(event.dtstamp)
36:     )));
37:     out.push_str(&timed_lines(event));
38:     out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
39:         "SUMMARY:{}",
40:         escape_text(&event.summary)
41:     )));
42:     if let Some(description) = &event.description {
43:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!(
44:             "DESCRIPTION:{}",
45:             escape_text(description)
46:         )));
47:     }
48:     if let Some(location) = &event.location {
49:         out.push_str(&fold_line(&format!("LOCATION:{}", escape_text(location))));
50:     }
51:     if let Some(status) = &event.status {

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out
150: }

118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out

502: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
503:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
504:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
505:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
506:         return None;

509:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
510:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
511:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
512:         return None;
513:     }
514:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
515: }

644: /// Canonical iCalendar content and strong ETag for one exposed event.
645: fn ical_and_etag(resource: &CaldavEventResource, event: &Event) -> Option<(String, String)> {
646:     let EventTiming::Timed {
647:         start_utc,
648:         end_utc,
649:         timezone,
650:     } = &event.timing
651:     else {
652:         return None;
653:     };
654:     let ical = serialize_event_resource(&CaldavIcalEvent {
655:         uid: resource.uid.clone(),
656:         summary: event.title.clone(),
657:         description: event.description.clone(),
658:         location: event.location.clone(),
659:         status: Some(
660:             match event.status {
661:                 EventStatus::Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
662:                 EventStatus::Confirmed => "CONFIRMED",
663:                 EventStatus::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
664:             }
665:             .to_owned(),
666:         ),
667:         start_utc: *start_utc,
668:         end_utc: *end_utc,
669:         timezone: timezone.clone(),
670:         dtstamp: event.created_at,
671:         sequence: event.version as u64,
672:     });
673:     let etag = etag_for_ical(&ical);
674:     Some((ical, etag))
675: }

770: async fn get_apple_connection(

773: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {

781: async fn create_apple_password(
782:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
783:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
784:     Json(request): Json<CreatePasswordRequest>,
785: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
786:     let label = request.label.trim().to_owned();
787:     if label.is_empty() || label.chars().count() > MAX_LABEL_LENGTH {
788:         return Err(ApiError::bad_request());
789:     }
790:     let issued = accounts
791:         .issue_credential(session.user.id, label)
792:         .await
793:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
794:     let response = CreatePasswordResponse {
795:         server_url: issued.server_url,
796:         username: issued.username,
797:         clear_password: issued.password.expose().to_owned(),
798:         password: issued.metadata,
799:     };
800:     Ok((StatusCode::CREATED, Json(response)))
801: }

803: async fn revoke_apple_password(
804:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
805:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
806:     Path(credential_id): Path<i64>,
807: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
808:     accounts
809:         .revoke_credential(session.user.id, credential_id)
810:         .await
811:         .map_err(|error| match error {
812:             CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::not_found(),
813:             other => map_caldav_error(other),
814:         })?;
815:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
816: }
817: 
818: async fn disconnect_apple(
819:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
820:     Extension(session): Extension<AuthenticatedSession>,
821: ) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, ApiError> {
822:     accounts
823:         .revoke_all(session.user.id)
824:         .await
825:         .map_err(map_caldav_error)?;
826:     Ok(StatusCode::NO_CONTENT)
827: }

829: fn map_caldav_error(error: CaldavAuthError) -> ApiError {
830:     match error {
831:         CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials | CaldavAuthError::Revoked => ApiError::bad_request(),
832:         CaldavAuthError::RateLimited => ApiError::rate_limited(),
833:         CaldavAuthError::Persistence => ApiError::internal(),
834:     }
835: }

97: async fn request(
98:     app: Router,
99:     method: Method,
100:     uri: &str,
101:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
102: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
103:     let mut builder = Request::builder().method(method).uri(uri);
104:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
105:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
106:     }
107:     let response = app
108:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap())
109:         .await
110:         .unwrap();
111:     let status = response.status();
112:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
113:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
114:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
115: }

551: async fn propfind_calendar(
552:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
553:     uri: &str,
554:     auth: (&str, &str),
555: ) -> String {
556:     let builder = Request::builder()
557:         .method(Method::from_bytes(b"PROPFIND").unwrap())
558:         .uri(uri)
559:         .header("depth", "1")
560:         .header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(auth.0, auth.1));
561:     let response = build_caldav_router(accounts.clone())
562:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap())
563:         .await
564:         .unwrap();
565:     assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::MULTI_STATUS);
566:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
567:     String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned()
568: }

570: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
571: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
572:     for line in body.lines() {
573:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
574:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
575:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
576:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
577:             return Some(name.to_owned());
578:         }
579:     }
580:     None
581: }

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {
119:     const LIMIT: usize = 73;
120:     if line.len() <= LIMIT {
121:         return format!("{line}\r\n");
122:     }
123:     let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
124:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len() + 16);
125:     let mut pos = 0;
126:     let mut first = true;
127:     while pos < chars.len() {
128:         let width = if first { LIMIT } else { LIMIT - 1 };
129:         let mut end = pos;
130:         while end < chars.len() {
131:             let segment: String = chars[pos..=end].iter().collect();
132:             if segment.len() > width {
133:                 break;
134:             }
135:             end += 1;
136:         }
137:         if end == pos {
138:             end = pos + 1;
139:         }
140:         let segment: String = chars[pos..end].iter().collect();
141:         if !first {
142:             out.push(' ');
143:         }
144:         out.push_str(&segment);
145:         out.push_str("\r\n");
146:         pos = end;
147:         first = false;
148:     }
149:     out
150: }

172: async fn dav_calendar(
173:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
174:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key)): Path<(String, String)>,
175:     request: Request,
176: ) -> Response {
177:     match request.method().as_str() {
178:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
179:         PROPFIND => {
180:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
181:                 return dav_unauthorized();
182:             };
183:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
184:                 return dav_unauthorized();
185:             };
186:             let Some(depth) = parse_depth(request.headers()) else {
187:                 return dav_bad_depth();
188:             };
189:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
190:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
191:                 Ok(None) => return dav_not_found(),
192:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
193:             };
194:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
195:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
196:             };
197:             let calendar = match accounts
198:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
199:                 .await
200:             {
201:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
202:                 Ok(None) => return dav_calendar_not_found(),
203:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
204:             };
205:             let path_principal_ok =
206:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
207:             if !path_principal_ok {
208:                 return dav_calendar_not_found();
209:             }
210:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
211:             let event_ids = match repository.list_exposed_event_ids(calendar_id).await {
212:                 Ok(event_ids) => event_ids,
213:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
214:             };
215:             let events = EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
216:             let now = accounts.now();
217:             let mut listed = Vec::new();
218:             for event_id in event_ids {
219:                 let resource = match repository.ensure_resource(calendar_id, event_id, now).await {
220:                     Ok(resource) => resource,
221:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
222:                 };
223:                 match events.event(calendar_id, event_id).await {
224:                     Ok(Some(event)) => {
225:                         if let Some((_, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) {
226:                             listed.push((resource, etag));
227:                         }
228:                     }
229:                     Ok(None) => {}
230:                     Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
231:                 }
232:             }
233:             render_calendar(&accounts, &principal_id, &calendar, depth, &listed)
234:         }
235:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
236:     }
237: }

239: async fn dav_event_resource(
240:     State(accounts): State<CaldavAccountService>,
241:     Path((principal_id, calendar_key, resource_name)): Path<(String, String, String)>,
242:     request: Request,
243: ) -> Response {
244:     match request.method().as_str() {
245:         OPTIONS => dav_capabilities(),
246:         "GET" | "HEAD" => {
247:             let head = request.method().as_str() == "HEAD";
248:             let Some(authorization) = request.headers().get(header::AUTHORIZATION) else {
249:                 return dav_unauthorized();
250:             };
251:             let Ok(session) = accounts.authenticate(authorization).await else {
252:                 return dav_unauthorized();
253:             };
254:             let principal = match accounts.resolve_principal(&principal_id).await {
255:                 Ok(Some(principal)) => principal,
256:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
257:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
258:             };
259:             if principal.user_id != session.user_id {
260:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
261:             }
262:             let Ok(calendar_id) = calendar_key.parse::<i64>() else {
263:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
264:             };
265:             let calendar = match accounts
266:                 .resolve_calendar(session.user_id, calendar_id)
267:                 .await
268:             {
269:                 Ok(Some(calendar)) => calendar,
270:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
271:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
272:             };
273:             let path_principal_ok =
274:                 principal.user_id == calendar.owner_user_id || principal.user_id == session.user_id;
275:             if !path_principal_ok {
276:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
277:             }
278:             let Some(resource_name) = resource_name.strip_suffix(".ics") else {
279:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
280:             };
281:             let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
282:             let resource = match repository.resolve_by_name(calendar_id, resource_name).await {
283:                 Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
284:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
285:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
286:             };
287:             let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
288:                 .event(calendar_id, resource.event_id)
289:                 .await
290:             {
291:                 Ok(Some(event)) => event,
292:                 Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
293:                 Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
294:             };
295:             let recurring: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
296:                 "SELECT EXISTS(
297:                     SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE id = ? AND recurrence_rule IS NOT NULL
298:                  )",
299:             )
300:             .bind(resource.event_id)
301:             .fetch_one(accounts.pool())
302:             .await
303:             .unwrap_or(false);
304:             if recurring {
305:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
306:             }
307:             let Some((ical, etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event) else {
308:                 return dav_resource_not_found();
309:             };
310:             let content_length = ical.len().to_string();
311:             let mut response = (
312:                 StatusCode::OK,
313:                 [
314:                     (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"),
315:                     (header::ETAG, etag.as_str()),
316:                     (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, content_length.as_str()),
317:                 ],
318:                 ical,
319:             )
320:                 .into_response();
321:             if head {
322:                 *response.body_mut() = Body::empty();
323:             }
324:             response
325:         }
326:         _ => method_not_allowed(),
327:     }
328: }

363: fn parse_depth(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> Option<DavDepth> {
364:     let value = headers.get("depth").and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
365:     match value {
366:         None => Some(DavDepth::One),
367:         Some(value) if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("0") => Some(DavDepth::Zero),
368:         Some(value) if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("1") => Some(DavDepth::One),
369:         Some(_) => None,
370:     }
371: }

470: fn privileges_for_role(role: &str) -> Vec<&'static str> {
471:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(role) else {
472:         return Vec::new();
473:     };
474:     let allows = |action: CalendarAction| {
475:         authorize_calendar_action(
476:             UserStatus::Active,
477:             Some(PlatformRole::User),
478:             Some(role),
479:             action,
480:         ) == AuthorizationDecision::Allow
481:     };
482:     let mut privileges = vec!["DAV:read-current-user-privilege-set"];
483:     let can_read = allows(CalendarAction::ReadDetails) || allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy);
484:     if can_read {
485:         privileges.push("DAV:read");
486:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-subscribe");
487:     }
488:     if allows(CalendarAction::ReadFreeBusy) {
489:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write-freebusy");
490:     }
491:     let writable = allows(CalendarAction::CreateEvent) || allows(CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent);
492:     if writable {
493:         privileges.push("DAV:write-content");
494:         privileges.push("DAV:calendar-write");
495:     }
496:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
497:         privileges.push("DAV:write-properties");
498:     }
499:     if allows(CalendarAction::ManageAcl) {
500:         privileges.push("DAV:read-acl");
501:         privileges.push("DAV:write-acl");
502:     }
503:     if writable && allows(CalendarAction::ManageSettings) {
504:         privileges.push("DAV:write");
505:     }
506:     if allows(CalendarAction::DeleteCalendar) {
507:         privileges.push("DAV:all");
508:     }
509:     privileges
510: }
